sentences.text: 1  Suit for Permanent and Mandatory Injunctions and Damages JUDGMENT 1.

This is a suit for Permanent and Mandatory Injunctions and Damages filed by plaintiff against the defendants for restraining the defendant no.1, his agents, attorney, relatives, legal heirs etc. from carrying any further construction on the roof or carry any illegal construction anywhere in his flat and for seeking directions to the defendants no.2 and 3 to remove wholly and completely all the illegal construction raised on the roof of Flat No.24D, ED Block, Pitampura, Delhi (hereinafter referred to as 'the suit property') and further directing the defendant no.1 to restore the roof in its original form as laid down by the defendant no.3 (DDA), install the water tank of the plaintiff's flat on the roof of Flat no.24C, ED Block and to make space and provision for ingress and egress of the plaintiff towards the water tank as laid down by the defendant no.3 (DDA).

It is also prayed that a decree of damages may also be passed in favour of the plaintiff thereby directing defendant no.1 to pay Rs. 1 lacs as damages/compensation to the plaintiff for causing damages to the plaintiff's flat.
Plaintiff's Case 2.

The brief facts as averred in the plaint are that the plaintiff is bonafide owner and occupant of DDA Flat No.24A, ED Block, Pitampura, Delhi (hereinafter referred to as 'the plaintiff's CS SCJ No.60540/2016 K.L Gauba Vs. Mulk Raj Sharma & Ors. Page no. 2 of 15 property').

sentences.text:
The property in which the flat of the plaintiff exists has three floors bearing no.ED-24A, ED-24B and ED-24C,
constructed by the defendant no.3 which were later handed over for all purposes to defendant no.2 and roof was for common use for installing water tanks and TV antennas by the respective occupants as per the building bye laws of the flats allotted by the defendant no.3.

It is stated that the second floor i.e. Flat no.24C is owned/occupied by the defendant no.1 and his family who in violation of building bye laws illegally and in an unauthorized manner encroached upon the common roof of the said building by raising illegal and unauthorized structure of a residential flats thereupon by covering the entire roof area without any due sanction or permission from the defendants no.2 and 3 in the year 1996.

It is stated that the plaintiff made complaint to the various authorities including defendants no. 2 and 3 against the said illegal construction and consequently,
a demolition order dated 05.06.1997 was passed by the then MCD authorities and a symbolic demolition action was carried out on 23.06.1997 and only partial action was taken and entire unauthorized construction was not demolished.
3. The issues between the plaintiff and defendant no.1 with respect to the installation of water tank from top to ground and thereafter from ground to top floor and other ancillary issues had amicably been settled before the Delhi Dispute Resolution Society (Regd.) vide mediation settlement dated 31.07.2013.
It is stated that the plaintiff is the owner and occupier of Flat no.ED 24A and B and defendant no.1 is residing at the second floor i.e. Flat no.24 C along with his family.

The plaintiff is residing at ground floor and he has let out the first floor flat to some Gunda elements who are using the same for commercial purpose and on the said floor, some unlawful activities are going on and since the stairs are common, the said gunda elements used to give dirty remarks and use abusive language whenever any female go downstairs.

It is stated that the plaintiff is having habit of filing false and frivolous complaints against the defendant no.1 for unauthorized construction and he is doing the same since 1997 and he is demanding Rs.10 lacs from the defendant no.1 for withdrawing the false and frivolous complaint filed against him before the MCD.
The plaintiff has himself done the illegal construction at the ground floor by covering the outside area with iron grills and using the public land.

During the cross examination of PW1, the plaintiff admitted that demolition order dated 05.06.1997 was passed by the MCD and symbolic/partial demolition action was taken on 23.06.1997.

As per the written statement of the defendant no.2/MCD, during the inspection of the suit property on 28.08.2015, it was noticed that demolished portions were repaired and property is fully furnished and occupied and it is also stated that qua the reconstruction of the demolished portion, a representation dated 31.08.2015 was made by the defendant no.1 to the defendant no.2/MCD which is still under consideration, however no such documents were proved by the defendant no.2/MCD in the Court nor any witness produced by the defendant no.2/MCD.
From the material available on record, it cannot be said that there is no cause of action in favour of the plaintiff.
Accordingly, both issues are decided in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendants.

This is a suit for Permanent and Mandatory Injunctions and Damages filed by plaintiff against the defendants for restraining the defendant no.1, his agents, attorney, relatives, legal heirs etc. from carrying any further construction on the roof or carry any illegal construction anywhere in his flat and for seeking directions to the defendants no.2 and 3 to remove wholly and completely all the illegal construction raised on the roof of Flat No.24D, ED Block, Pitampura, Delhi (hereinafter referred to as 'the suit property') and further directing the defendant no.1 to restore the roof in its original form as laid down by the defendant no.3 (DDA), install the water tank of the plaintiff's flat on the roof of Flat no.24C, ED Block and to make space and provision for ingress and egress of the plaintiff towards the water tank as laid down by the defendant no.3 (DDA).
The brief facts as averred in the plaint are that the plaintiff is bonafide owner and occupant of DDA Flat No.24A, ED Block, Pitampura, Delhi (hereinafter referred to as 'the plaintiff's CS SCJ No.60540/2016 K.L Gauba Vs. Mulk Raj Sharma & Ors. Page no. 2 of 15 property').
The plaintiff made police complaint and also sent a legal notice to the defendants no.2 and 3 on 17.11.2014 thereby asking both the defendants to demolish the said illegal and CS SCJ No.60540/2016 K.L Gauba Vs. Mulk Raj Sharma & Ors.
Hence, the present suit.
wherein it is contended that no statutory notice as required under Section 477/478 of the DMC Act has been served prior to filing of the present suit.
Accordingly, the CS SCJ No.60540/2016 K.L Gauba Vs. Mulk Raj Sharma &
Ors. Page no. 11 of 15 issue is decided in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendants.
Plaintiff has proved that there is illegal construction on the roof top of the Flat No.24C and which was admittedly booked by the defendant no.2/MCD for unauthorized construction of one room and projection on government land with RCC pillar at SF, u/c of three rooms, one toilet, two kithcnes and projection on government land at TF has been booked vide u/c file No.139/B/UC/RZ/97 dated 5.6.1997.

Issue No.6 : Whether the suit of the plaintiff is devoid of cause of action on account of alleged unauthorized construction having already been demolished on 30.06.97 as per preliminary objection no.2?OPD-2 18.
During the cross examination of PW1, the plaintiff admitted that demolition order dated 05.06.1997 was passed by the MCD and symbolic/partial demolition action was taken on 23.06.1997.
No evidence brought by the plaintiff to the effect that protection granted by the aforesaid Act is still not in force.
opennyai_summary.decision:
After following due process of law demolition order was passed on 23.6.1997 and Partly demolition action was taken on 30.6.1997.
However, no relief can be granted to the plaintiff as the suit property is protected by the National Capital Territory of Delhi Laws (Special Provisions) Second Amendment Act 2014 till 31.12.2023 or till such time the said protection is extended or applicable by the Parliament/Government.
Accordingly, the issues no.1, 2 and 3 are decided in favour of the defendants and against the plaintiff.
In the light of above discussions and my issue wise findings given above, the suit of the plaintiff is dismissed.
Decree sheet be prepared accordingly.
